Needs changes before merge.

### Requested before merge

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/boundary.rs:115`: Add before/after screenshots to the PR body. Show the old Boundary group and the new group with both offset rows. The PR changes UI controls, but its body has no screenshots. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link the images from the PR body.

### Code review

This is a safety review because the change controls the machining region. Equal offsets retain the old rule. The tests cover the new region, project migration, undo, and MCP. No goldens changed, so no changed golden lines needed review. I found no code blocker in the diff.

### Local results

I trial-merged this head with upstream main `62353ac753947eba162538e0d9305ad86858cfb3`. The merge had no conflicts. I used a separate local target directory in `.claude/worktrees/review-3386`. No GitHub runner ran.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 47 steps; 45 passed and 2 failed. Both app and UI builds passed. Tests: 1945 passed, 2 failed, 12 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- Both new UI tests passed. All four `area_outer_offset` tests passed.

The two failed tests also fail on unmodified upstream main at the SHA above. I ran each failing test there. The assertion and values were the same. These failures are not regressions from this PR:

- `crates/app/tests/blind_slot.rs:142`, `blind_slot_pocket_family_cuts_from_end_wall_to_stock_edge`:

```text
assertion `left == right` failed: Adaptive2D
  left: 1
 right: 0
```

- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/post_dialog_tests.rs:69`, `desktop_post_command_opens_dialog_and_applies_declared_script_options_undoably`:

```text
assertion `left == right` failed: clicking Write tool list at [[551.0 514.0] - [569.0 532.0]] must toggle draft value
  left: Some(Bool(false))
 right: Some(Bool(true))
```

### Mutations repeated locally

I ran `a_negative_outer_offset_pulls_in_the_stock_side_and_keeps_the_picked_edge` for each mutation.

| Mutation | Mutated result | Result after restoration |
|---|---|---|
| Disable the split-offset guard in step 2 | Failed: `the outer edge moves in: -45 45 45` | All 4 tests in `area_outer_offset` passed |
| Make `grow_apart` grow by `outer` only | Failed: `the picked edge stays on the chain: 30` | All 4 tests in `area_outer_offset` passed |

The restored test measured feed length from 605.8 mm to 315.8 mm. I restored both mutations. The working tree is clean.

### Extra suites run

- Ran the full `area_outer_offset` suite after each mutation restoration.
- Repeated the failing `blind_slot` test on the trial merge and on unmodified upstream main.
- Ran the failing UI post-dialog test on unmodified upstream main. UI tests ran from `crates/ui`.
- The diff changes no test fixtures or importer code. The extra fixture and STEP import rules do not select another suite.

### Limits and notes

The author reports 205 app steps passed with `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`. I did not repeat that release-mode run locally. The PR body identifies the Face and ring cases that lack new offset tests.

The initial compiler-cache invocation stalled. I stopped it. Completed checks used `RUSTC_WRAPPER=` and `CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0`.

Second read (read-only, not built) of head 35d28b002cf31a46abc6cbbf45ae2618f2e4b170.

**Verdict: no defect found by reading.** I found no gouge path and no silent path change for an old project. Three notes follow. They are not blockers.

### Geometry

- The old single offset was applied in `crates/app/src/operation/boundary.rs` step 2 (`grow(&area, c.offset)`), and the far side was shrunk by `-c.offset`.
- Now (`boundary.rs:270-277`): with no open boundary, or with equal values, the old `grow` path runs unchanged. With an open boundary and different values, `boundary_turn::grow_apart` (`boundary_turn.rs:143-146`) grows the kept side by `max(offset, outer_offset)` and intersects it with the stock reach grown by `outer_offset`.
- The far side is still shrunk by `offset` and subtracted unconditionally (`boundary.rs:276` and the `far_side` difference after step 3). Thus the picked line is always set by `offset` only, as before.
- Signs: `offset` + moves the picked line into the far side (toward the part), - moves it into the kept side. `outer_offset` + moves the stock-side line out, - moves it in. Islands (the part material) and the containment are applied after step 2, as before. A closed area and its islands read `offset` only.
- `contour_open.rs:127` (Contour on an open boundary) still reads `offset` only. That agrees with the summary, which shows the outer line only for families other than Contour.

Hand trace, side B strip on a rectangular stock, picked edge, `offset` +1, `outer_offset` -2:
- Before (one value +1): the picked line moves 1 mm toward the part. The outer line is at the reach (stock + 2R) plus 1 mm.
- After: the picked line moves 1 mm toward the part (the same as before). The outer line is at the reach minus 2 mm.
- The picked line is never past its old position. The outer line moves only by the value that the user typed. The part material is removed later by the island step, as before. I found no case where the new code lets the tool cross a line that the old code kept for the same `offset`.
- The pin `a_negative_outer_offset_pulls_in_the_stock_side_and_keeps_the_picked_edge` checks the same shape (picked +1, outer -10: y 19 and +-35).
- Degenerate values: a region that collapses goes to `check(..., "outer boundary offset")`, which is a clean refusal. Non-finite or too large values are refused at the door (`types/area.rs:141`, `dist(self.outer_offset)`), pinned by `the_outer_offset_rides_the_door_and_the_undo`.

### Project file

- `project/area.rs`: `outer_offset: Option<f64>`, absent means equal to `offset` (`unwrap_or(self.offset)`). The key is written only when the two values differ. An old file loads one value into both, the old path runs, and the stamp does not change (`boundary_ctx.rs:256-260`). Pinned by `an_old_project_offset_loads_into_both_and_saves_the_same_bytes`.
- New default: both 0.
- An older build that opens a file with the key: `AreaDto` has no `deny_unknown_fields`, so the older build ignores the key and uses `offset` for both lines. The picked line is the same. Only the outer line differs, and that line is in air beyond the stock. This is not a gouge. I do not think it is an incompatible change that needs `fix!:`, but the maintainer can decide.

### Operation kinds and goldens

`resolve` is the one area law (`operation/area.rs:36`). I found no other reader of `AreaControls::offset` in the planners except `contour_open.rs` (above). No golden changed.

### Commands and MCP

- The value goes through `EditOperationParams::with_area`. Undo restores the two values (app and UI tests).
- MCP `set_operation_area` takes and shows `outer_offset`. `only_keys` refuses unknown keys. `docs/agents/mcp-tools.md` is updated.
- Note 1: in `mcp/area.rs`, an omitted `outer_offset` is 0. An old MCP caller that sends only `offset` on an open boundary now moves the picked line only, not the outer line. The schema says that omitted fields take their defaults, so this agrees with the tool contract. It is not a gouge.

### UI

- Two rows: "Inside boundary offset" and "Outside boundary offset", each with its own hint. The test `the_boundary_group_has_an_inside_and_an_outside_offset_row` checks the labels, the order, the draft, Apply and undo. It is a behaviour test.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/boundary.rs`: 437 lines before, 439 now. The PR makes it 2 lines longer and does not split it. `crates/app/src/operation/boundary.rs`: 406 lines now. Note 2: the two files are over the 400-line rule. A follow-up split is a `P7` item.
- Screenshots: yes. The PR body has before and after images.
- Note 3: the issue says that each offset applies to a closed boundary and an open boundary. The PR makes a closed area ignore `outer_offset`, and the summary gives a notice. The decision file says this, but it does not list it under "Dropped" as a change from the issue text.

### Tests and gate

- `area_outer_offset.rs` (4 tests) proves the separation, the old law with equal values, the migration and the door. `mcp_pick.rs` gets new assertions; none was removed. `do_not_touch.rs` only makes the harness taller; the assertions did not change.
- The author's gate ran with `--base upstream/main`. The body does not name the SHA. The merge base of the head is `7a626a7f5`.
- Heavy lanes: the body says `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`, 205 app steps, 0 failed. The body does not name the separate lanes or the head SHA of that run.
- `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!`: only in test code. The `Changelog:` line is present. The decision file is `docs/decisions/3338-outer-boundary-offset.md`.

### Earlier requests

The screenshot request of the first review is complete at this head. The reviewer withdrew it.

### Not judged without a run

- The Face family and a closed ring as the open boundary with two different values (not pinned, as the body says).
- The interaction of `extension` with an outer line that is pulled in.
- The heavy-lane results.
